title: Gambling Managers
description: Plan, direct, or coordinate gambling operations in a casino. May formulate house rules.

tasks.text: Resolve customer complaints regarding problems, such as payout errors.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Complaint resolution needs authority and rapport

dwas.name: Resolve customer complaints or problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Remove suspected cheaters, such as card counters or other players who may have systems that shift the odds of winning to their favor.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Enforcement coordination requires legal authority and presence

dwas.name: Coordinate enforcement of laws or regulations.

tasks.text: Track supplies of money to tables and perform any required paperwork.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Cash flow tracking is digital and analyzable

dwas.name: Monitor flow of cash or other resources.

tasks.text: Explain and interpret house rules, such as game rules or betting limits.
tasks.rationale: text generation — AI drafts policy communications; human approves

dwas.name: Communicate organizational policies and procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Prepare work schedules and station arrangements and keep attendance records.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain structured personnel records in systems

dwas.name: Prepare staff schedules or work assignments.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Monitor staffing levels to ensure that games and tables are adequately staffed for each shift, arranging for staff rotations and breaks and locating substitute employees as necessary.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Broad resource monitoring needs human judgment and physical checks

tasks.text: Maintain familiarity with all games used at a facility, as well as strategies or tricks employed in those games.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI summarizes developments; human retains expertise

dwas.name: Maintain knowledge of current developments in area of expertise.

tasks.text: Train new workers or evaluate their performance.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Performance review aided; accountability and context human

dwas.name: Evaluate employee performance.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Market or promote the casino to bring in business.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Promotional materials drafted; human executes outreach
interpersonal — Live interviewing is human relational work

dwas.name: Interview employees, customers, or others to collect information.

tasks.text: Direct the distribution of complimentary hotel rooms, meals, or other discounts or free items given to players, based on their length of play and betting totals.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Guest services management is live human relationship work

tasks.text: Establish policies on issues, such as the type of gambling offered and the odds, the extension of credit, or the serving of food and beverages.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts policies; accountability and context are human

tasks.text: Circulate among gaming tables to ensure that operations are conducted properly, that dealers follow house rules, or that players are not cheating.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Live monitoring of people in physical settings

dwas.name: Monitor activities of individuals to ensure safety or compliance with rules.

tasks.text: Set and maintain a bank and table limit for each game.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI models pricing; human sets monetary policy

tasks.text: Direct the compilation of summary sheets that show wager amounts and payoffs for races or events.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Compiling operational data from sources is automatable

tasks.text: Review operational expenses, budget estimates, betting accounts, or collection reports for accuracy.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Audit fieldwork and attestation remain human-owned

dwas.name: Conduct financial or regulatory audits.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Record, collect, or pay off bets, issuing receipts as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — In-person payment handling; some digital automation

dwas.name: Collect payments for goods or services.

tasks.text: Notify board attendants of table vacancies so that waiting patrons can play.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Embodied signaling in shared physical workspace

dwas.name: Signal others to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.rationale: decision support — Broad resource monitoring needs human judgment and physical checks

emerging_tasks.task: Monitor the performance of the gaming floor, relocating games and installing new games as necessary.
